reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator is the cognitive expectation of goal-object (E_G), which is a function of physiological drive (D) and goal-object type (G). It is modeled as a latent variable that mediates between internal drive and external behavior. When a new reward is introduced, E_G evolves through repeated exposure (R) over time (T), forming a dynamic belief system. This belief system is central to both GSI's Bayesian inference engine, where E_G acts as a prior, and GSE's state-transition engine, where E_G influences action selection. The dual nature of E_G manifests in its role as both a predictor of reward valence and a driver of adaptive behavior. Failure modes include stale expectations (no new experiences) or misaligned expectations (inconsistent reward feedback). The mathematical structure supports a recursive update mechanism where E_G(t+1) = f(E_G(t), R(t), T(t)), enabling both prediction and control.
